newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end 5-day losing streak, volume thin.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end 5-day losing streak, volume thin.

text.p: Tokyo stocks snapped out of their five-day losing streak on Monday, ending on a positive tone.
Brokers said, however, that turnover was extremely thin as most investors were on the sidelines, searching for sound reasons to trade on.

The stock market's benchmark 225-issue Nikkei average was 145.44 points or 0.70 percent higher at 20,885.41. In the futures market, the key December futures contract added 200 points to settle at 20,970.
"Trade was extremely dull today and the benchmark Nikkei's rise was feeble and not really strong enough to be considered a rebound," a broker at a second-tier brokerage said.
